sloka: स हि तस्याभिसङ्क्रुद्धः प्रगृह्य विपुलां शिलाम्।विरूपाक्षाय चिक्षेप सुग्रीवो जलदोपमाम् ।। ६.९७.२२ ।।
transliteration: sa hi tasyābhisaṅkruddhaḥ pragṛhya vipulāṁ śilām।virūpākṣāya cikṣepa sugrīvo jaladopamām ।। 6.97.22 ।।

translations.english: Holding a huge rock which was like a mass of clouds, Sugriva, who was very angry, hurled at Virupaksha.
